remarks: Video Tour located on YouTube Channel @JaneWagnerWR. Location, Luxury and Lifestyle is found in this stunning Silvermine residence. Nestled on the private rear lot in the coveted & historic South Wilton neighborhood convenient to both Wilton & New Canaan village centers, schools, train and major highways. This exceptional custom-built home with four finished floors has been meticulously maintained and refined. Stunningly impressive upon approach with New England stone walls & landscaped gardens are testament to the extraordinary quality throughout. The beautiful & bright interior features gracefully proportioned rooms with wide halls, high ceilings, five fireplaces & the perfect layout designed for living, working & entertaining. The heart of the home is the sunlit chef's kitchen and breakfast room with panoramic garden and pool views. Open the French Doors to the lovely patio overlooking the private, flat backyard. Here you'll find a heated salt-water pool with spa and outdoor kitchen perfect for leisurely gatherings. The primary suite is a true sanctuary featuring the private balcony, stunning fireplace, his & her walk-in closets & large spa-like bath with radiant heat floors. The lower level is equally impressive & offers the gym & spa room with the full bath, closet & electrical for a potential sauna. *** The sellers are asking for best offers to be submitted by Monday, Aug. 12th close of business.
